news.title: Qatargate suspect Urich continued boosting Doha’s PR image after Oct. 7 massacre - report
news.summary: According to N12, citing Urich during his interrogation and investigation in connection to the Qatargate scandal, Urich admitted to having worked with Qatar until at least the middle of 2024.

news.title: Tel Aviv's Zemack Gallery goes on an American Dream ‘Road Trip’ with artist Yigal Ozeri
news.summary: Israeli-born painter Yigal Ozeri returns to themes of American iconography in his new solo exhibition, Road Trip, debuting October 22 at the Zemack Gallery in Tel Aviv.

news.title: Eretz Israel Museum to host 'MUZA on the Line' at Tel Aviv Light Rail's Allenby station
news.summary: The exhibition showcases the talents of more than 20 prominent Israeli artists and creators, including Meira Una, Dafna Birger, and Esti Drori.

news.title: Rebels, romance, and revolution: Hollywood classics return to the big screen in Tel Aviv
news.summary: The Tel Aviv Museum of Art celebrates American cinema of the 1960s and 70s with screenings of Hollywood classics, from The Graduate to Easy Rider, October 22-24.
